I replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was **Southgate**.

The source is this same incident channel, which Tobias belongs to. On 3 Sep 2025 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she reported it resolved and said Southgate had cleared the backlog. The GBrain search returned the same conversation.

None of the files Tobias can see have more about the site, such as an address or site ID. I told him that and suggested he ask Priyanka before the call if he needs those details.
